meta.title: A comment made only of spaces or blank lines counts as no comment
gaps: Log in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval request email.
Click Reject in the email and verify the new email subject starts with Action:Reject.
Enter only spaces or blank lines in the required comment field.
Send the rejection email without changing its subject.
Wait for Procol to read the mailbox and verify the bounce-back says no comment was given.
Verify that nothing was recorded in the approval workflow or buyer portal.
